definitions.gloss: going to bed; retiring for the night
definitions.explanation: The act of going to sleep, often used in formal or institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {就寝|しゅうしん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧10⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧です。
{就寝|しゅうしん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ない→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I don't look at my smartphone before bed.
According to school rules, wake-up time is 6 o'clock and bedtime is 10 o'clock.

notes:
{就寝|しゅうしん} is a formal word for going to bed or retiring for the night. It is more commonly seen in written language, schedules, and institutional settings than in casual conversation.

ETYMOLOGY:
{就|しゅう} (to take up, to settle into) + {寝|しん} (sleep).

COMPOUNDS:
- {就寝|しゅうしん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: bedtime
- {就寝|しゅうしん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: before bed
- {就寝|しゅうしん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: while sleeping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {就寝|しゅうしん}: going to bed (formal)
- ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep, to go to bed (everyday)
- ⟦{起床|きしょう}→起床：00237_kishou⟧: waking up, getting up (formal opposite)

REGISTER:
Used in schedules (⟦{起床|きしょう}→起床：00237_kishou⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧、{就寝|しゅうしん}10⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧), hotel and dormitory rules, health advice articles, and formal writing. In conversation, ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ is the natural choice.
